description: run_with_retries(fn, attempts) in retrier.py should call fn up to `attempts` times total, returning the first successful result and re-raising the last exception if all fail. It currently calls fn only attempts-1 times, so a function that would succeed on its final allowed attempt never gets it. Fix retrier.py.
source_pattern: Retry loop using range(attempts-1), making one fewer call than allowed.
